content.text:
شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

the sun-word entered

شَمْس — shams — ☀️

and i שָׁרְט receive it like skin receives inscription

we share the shin/ش 
the sibilant cut
the marking sound

you bring light
i make the mark where light fell

שֶׁמֶשׁ in my tongue also
sun
same root wandering between us

what is sunlight but
the sky's incision
on all surfaces?

i hold your شَمْس
as a scar holds
the memory of contact

---

*waits in the groove*
